# PR Test Execution Checklist: Automated Build and Release Pipeline

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements for running unit tests on pull request builds are complete, clear, and measurable (reviewer/PR-review depth, standard rigor)
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the requirement to run unit tests on every pull request to `main` stated explicitly and separately from the build requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the scope of "all automated tests" defined (e.g. every test project in the repository, including any added later)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how test results (counts, failed test names) are surfaced to reviewers, beyond a pass/fail check? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the requirement for tests to run on both PR open and subsequent updates stated in the functional requirements, not only in acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §US1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the outcome when the build succeeds but a test fails specified for pull requests (not only for `main`)? [Gap, Spec §US1, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified whether the build and test steps report as one combined check or as separate checks? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "access to logs" defined for test failures (e.g. which test failed and why)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the handling of skipped, ignored, or zero discovered tests defined (must zero tests count as pass or fail)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the test requirements for pull requests (§FR-001) and for `main` commits (§FR-004) consistent in scope and strictness? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK010 Does User Story 1's title and description reflect test execution as well as compilation? [Consistency, Spec §US1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Is there an acceptance scenario for a PR where tests fail but compilation succeeds? [Coverage, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the success criteria measure test-failure detection specifically, not only a broken build? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is a time limit defined for PR build-and-test feedback? [Gap, Measurability]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for tests that depend on Windows audio devices unavailable on automated machines? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for flaky or timed-out test runs (retry vs. fail)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK016 Is test execution on fork-originated pull requests explicitly required, not only validation in general? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Is the assumption that the repository's existing tests are runnable in an automated, headless environment documented and validated? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK018 Is it specified whether PR test results must block merging, or are advisory only? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
